definitions.explanation: A soft, soupy dish made by cooking rice in a large amount of water until it becomes very soft. Commonly eaten when sick or for gentle nourishment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦お{粥|かゆ}→お粥：16857_okayu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: When I have a cold, I eat rice porridge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅干|うめぼ}し→梅干し：13110_umeboshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦お{粥|かゆ}→お粥：16857_okayu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Rice porridge with pickled plum is delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{七草|ななくさ}{粥|がゆ}→七草粥：22751_nanakusagayu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{無病息災|むびょうそくさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{願|ねが}う→願う：02387_negau⟧。
examples.english: We eat seven-herb porridge and pray for good health.

notes:
Usually used with the polite prefix お as ⟦お{粥|かゆ}→お粥：16857_okayu⟧. Also read as かい in some compounds.

TYPES:
- ⟦お{粥|かゆ}→お粥：16857_okayu⟧: plain rice porridge
- ⟦{七草|ななくさ}{粥|がゆ}→七草粥：22751_nanakusagayu⟧: seven-herb porridge (eaten January 7)
- {茶|ちゃ}{粥|がゆ}: tea porridge (Nara/Wakayama specialty)
- {卵|たまご}{粥|がゆ}: egg porridge

CULTURE: Eating ⟦{七草|ななくさ}{粥|がゆ}→七草粥：22751_nanakusagayu⟧ on January 7th ({人日|じんじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{節句|せっく}→節句：26925_sekku⟧) is a long-standing Japanese tradition. The seven spring herbs are believed to promote good health and give the stomach a rest after the rich New Year's food.

NUANCE: ⟦お{粥|かゆ}→お粥：16857_okayu⟧ is strongly associated with being ill in Japan. Offering to make someone ⟦お{粥|かゆ}→お粥：16857_okayu⟧ is a caring gesture, similar to making chicken soup in Western cultures.
